### The Angels and Lot
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/angels-and-lot
Passage: Genesis 19:1-3
Points:
- Two angels arrive at Sodom in the evening after departing from Abraham, meeting Lot at the city entrance.
- Lot sitting in the gate signifies high standing among city elders, revealing his spiritual compromise and entwinement with Sodom's corrupt culture.
- Aware of the dangers within the city square at night, Lot strongly urges the visitors to seek safety and lodging inside his home.
- Generous hospitality toward strangers and visitors serves as an essential evidence of authentic faith.
